command-failed: Claim Navigator: the server did not execute "{0}": {1}. The remaining commands were not sent
claim-too-small: Claim Navigator: the area {0}×{1}×{2} is too small, it must be at least {3}×{3}×{3}. Move the points
expand-too-small: Claim Navigator: each direction must be expanded by at least {0} blocks
expand-one-side: Claim Navigator: only one side can be selected at a time — leave a number in one field only. Do the next side after "Add claim"
area-not-adjacent: Claim Navigator: the selection does not touch the claim. Expand it up to the claim border
area-overlaps-added: Claim Navigator: the selection overlaps an area already added to this claim. Move the points
area-overlaps-own: Claim Navigator: the selection overlaps your claim "{0}". Move the points or expand the selection differently
area-overlaps: Claim Navigator: the selection overlaps a claim of {0}. Move the points or expand the selection differently
hint-rename-claim: Change the claim name. Access and borders stay the same
hint-rename-save: Saves the claim under the new name
rename-empty: Claim Navigator: enter a new claim name
hint-members-resolve-names: Asks the server for the names of members shown as UID. Access is not changed; takes about 1.5 seconds per member
hint-access-doors-all: Allows everyone to open/close doors and trapdoors in the claim
hint-access-doors-nothing: Forbids everyone from opening/closing doors and trapdoors in the claim
busy: Claim Navigator: previous commands are still running, wait a couple of seconds
claim-not-found: Claim Navigator: claim not found, list refreshed
hint-members-claim: Who has access to the claim: players, groups and general access. Access is granted and revoked here too
hint-member-group-unknown: You are not in this group, so its name is unknown. Remove it via "Group access" by typing the group name
hint-members-remove-all: Revokes access for every listed player and group and turns general access off
hint-member-everyone: General access: applies to every player without access of their own
hint-expand-directions: Selects a strip as many blocks wide as entered above, right next to the claim on one side. No points needed. If the claim has several areas, the side is measured from the one you stand in (or the nearest). The selection can then be expanded; press "Expand" when done
expand-nothing: Claim Navigator: enter a number of blocks for at least one direction
hint-cancel-edit: Discards unsaved changes of the claim
hint-expand-save: Adds the selection to the claim and saves it. Before sending, the mod checks that the selection touches the claim and does not overlap other claims
hint-allocate-claim: Highlight boundaries of the selected claim.
hint-cancel-claim: Remove the boundaries of any claims.
hint-general-claim: Settings for general access to the claim.
hint-player-claim: Settings for player access to the claim.
hint-group-claim: Settings for group access to the claim.
hint-player-use: Allows the selected player to use blocks in the claim (but not break them).
hint-player-all: Allows the selected player full interaction with the claim.
hint-player-traverse: Allows the specified player to open/close doors and trapdoors.
hint-player-delete: Revokes all access for the selected player from the claim.
hint-access-all: Allows everyone to use blocks in the claim (but not break them).
hint-access-nothing: Forbids everyone from using blocks in the claim.
hint-all-group: Allows the selected group full interaction with the claim.
hint-use-group: Allows the selected group to use blocks in the claim (but not break them).
hint-traverse-group: Allows the specified group to open/close doors and trapdoors.
hint-unassign-group: Revokes all access for the selected group from the claim.
hint-create-claim-new: Start the creation of a new claim.
hint-create-claim-start: Set the starting corner point for the claim area.
hint-create-claim-end: Set the ending corner point for the claim area.
hint-create-claim-grow: Grows the claim area in any direction by the number of blocks specified above.
hint-create-claim-add: Adds the newly defined area to the claim.
hint-create-claim-save: Saves the claim with the name entered above.
hint-expand-claim: Allows you to attach additional areas to an existing claim without using the claim limit (must be contiguous to the main claim).
